ESV.1: “And you, son of man, prophesy against Gog and say, Thus says the Lord GOD: Behold, I am against you, O Gog, chief prince of Meshech  and Tubal.
ESV.2: And I will turn you about and drive you forward,  and bring you up from the uttermost parts of the north, and lead you against the mountains of Israel.
ESV.3: Then I will strike your bow from your left hand, and will make your arrows drop out of your right hand.
ESV.4: You shall fall on the mountains of Israel, you and all your hordes and the peoples who are with you. I will give you to birds of prey of every sort and to the beasts of the field to be devoured.
ESV.5: You shall fall in the open field, for I have spoken, declares the Lord GOD.
ESV.6: I will send fire on Magog and on those who dwell securely in the coastlands, and they shall know that I am the LORD.
ESV.7: “And my holy name I will make known in the midst of my people Israel, and I will not let my holy name be profaned anymore. And the nations shall know that I am the LORD, the Holy One in Israel.
ESV.8: Behold, it is coming and it will be brought about, declares the Lord GOD. That is the day of which I have spoken.
ESV.9: “Then those who dwell in the cities of Israel will go out and make fires of the weapons and burn them, shields and bucklers, bow and arrows, clubs  and spears; and they will make fires of them for seven years,
ESV.10: so that they will not need to take wood out of the field or cut down any out of the forests, for they will make their fires of the weapons. They will seize the spoil of those who despoiled them, and plunder those who plundered them, declares the Lord GOD.
ESV.11: “On that day I will give to Gog a place for burial in Israel, the Valley of the Travelers, east of the sea. It will block the travelers, for there Gog and all his multitude will be buried. It will be called the Valley of Hamon-gog.
ESV.12: For seven months the house of Israel will be burying them, in order to cleanse the land.
ESV.13: All the people of the land will bury them, and it will bring them renown on the day that I show my glory, declares the Lord GOD.
ESV.14: They will set apart men to travel through the land regularly and bury those travelers remaining on the face of the land, so as to cleanse it. At  the end of seven months they will make their search.
ESV.15: And when these travel through the land and anyone sees a human bone, then he shall set up a sign by it, till the buriers have buried it in the Valley of Hamon-gog.
ESV.16: (Hamonah  is also the name of the city.) Thus shall they cleanse the land.
ESV.17: “As for you, son of man, thus says the Lord GOD: Speak to the birds of every sort and to all beasts of the field: ‘Assemble and come, gather from all around to the sacrificial feast that I am preparing for you, a great sacrificial feast on the mountains of Israel, and you shall eat flesh and drink blood.
ESV.18: You shall eat the flesh of the mighty, and drink the blood of the princes of the earth — of rams, of lambs, and of he-goats, of bulls, all of them fat beasts of Bashan.
ESV.19: And you shall eat fat till you are filled, and drink blood till you are drunk, at the sacrificial feast that I am preparing for you.
ESV.20: And you shall be filled at my table with horses and charioteers, with mighty men and all kinds of warriors,’ declares the Lord GOD.
ESV.21: “And I will set my glory among the nations, and all the nations shall see my judgment that I have executed, and my hand that I have laid on them.
ESV.22: The house of Israel shall know that I am the LORD their God, from that day forward.
ESV.23: And the nations shall know that the house of Israel went into captivity for their iniquity, because they dealt so treacherously with me that I hid my face from them and gave them into the hand of their adversaries, and they all fell by the sword.
ESV.24: I dealt with them according to their uncleanness and their transgressions, and hid my face from them.
ESV.25: “Therefore thus says the Lord GOD: Now I will restore the fortunes of Jacob and have mercy on the whole house of Israel, and I will be jealous for my holy name.
ESV.26: They shall forget their shame and all the treachery they have practiced against me, when they dwell securely in their land with none to make them afraid,
ESV.27: when I have brought them back from the peoples and gathered them from their enemies' lands, and through them have vindicated my holiness in the sight of many nations.
ESV.28: Then they shall know that I am the LORD their God, because I sent them into exile among the nations and then assembled them into their own land. I will leave none of them remaining among the nations anymore.
ESV.29: And I will not hide my face anymore from them, when I pour out my Spirit upon the house of Israel, declares the Lord GOD.”

NKJV.1: “And you, son of man, prophesy against Gog, and say, ‘Thus says the Lord GOD: “Behold, I am against you, O Gog, the prince of Rosh, Meshech, and Tubal;
NKJV.2: and I will turn you around and lead you on, bringing you up from the far north, and bring you against the mountains of Israel.
NKJV.3: Then I will knock the bow out of your left hand, and cause the arrows to fall out of your right hand.
NKJV.4: You shall fall upon the mountains of Israel, you and all your troops and the peoples who are with you; I will give you to birds of prey of every sort and to the beasts of the field to be devoured.
NKJV.5: You shall fall on the open field; for I have spoken,” says the Lord GOD.
NKJV.6: “And I will send fire on Magog and on those who live in security in the coastlands. Then they shall know that I am the LORD.
NKJV.7: So I will make My holy name known in the midst of My people Israel, and I will not let them profane My holy name anymore. Then the nations shall know that I am the LORD, the Holy One in Israel.
NKJV.8: Surely it is coming, and it shall be done,” says the Lord GOD. “This is the day of which I have spoken.
NKJV.9: “Then those who dwell in the cities of Israel will go out and set on fire and burn the weapons, both the shields and bucklers, the bows and arrows, the javelins and spears; and they will make fires with them for seven years.
NKJV.10: They will not take wood from the field nor cut down any from the forests, because they will make fires with the weapons; and they will plunder those who plundered them, and pillage those who pillaged them,” says the Lord GOD.
NKJV.11: “It will come to pass in that day that I will give Gog a burial place there in Israel, the valley of those who pass by east of the sea; and it will obstruct travelers, because there they will bury Gog and all his multitude. Therefore they will call it the Valley of Hamon Gog.
NKJV.12: For seven months the house of Israel will be burying them, in order to cleanse the land.
NKJV.13: Indeed all the people of the land will be burying, and they will gain renown for it on the day that I am glorified,” says the Lord GOD.
NKJV.14: “They will set apart men regularly employed, with the help of a search party, to pass through the land and bury those bodies remaining on the ground, in order to cleanse it. At the end of seven months they will make a search.
NKJV.15: The search party will pass through the land; and when anyone sees a man’s bone, he shall set up a marker by it, till the buriers have buried it in the Valley of Hamon Gog.
NKJV.16: The name of the city will also be Hamonah. Thus they shall cleanse the land.” ’
NKJV.17: “And as for you, son of man, thus says the Lord GOD, ‘Speak to every sort of bird and to every beast of the field:  “Assemble yourselves and come; Gather together from all sides to My sacrificial meal Which I am sacrificing for you, A great sacrificial meal on the mountains of Israel, That you may eat flesh and drink blood.
NKJV.18: You shall eat the flesh of the mighty, Drink the blood of the princes of the earth, Of rams and lambs, Of goats and bulls, All of them fatlings of Bashan.
NKJV.19: You shall eat fat till you are full, And drink blood till you are drunk, At My sacrificial meal Which I am sacrificing for you.
NKJV.20: You shall be filled at My table With horses and riders,  With mighty men And with all the men of war,” says the Lord GOD.
NKJV.21: “I will set My glory among the nations; all the nations shall see My judgment which I have executed, and My hand which I have laid on them.
NKJV.22: So the house of Israel shall know that I am the LORD their God from that day forward.
NKJV.23: The Gentiles shall know that the house of Israel went into captivity for their iniquity; because they were unfaithful to Me, therefore I hid My face from them. I gave them into the hand of their enemies, and they all fell by the sword.
NKJV.24: According to their uncleanness and according to their transgressions I have dealt with them, and hidden My face from them.” ’
NKJV.25: “Therefore thus says the Lord GOD: ‘Now I will bring back the captives of Jacob, and have mercy on the whole house of Israel; and I will be jealous for My holy name—
NKJV.26: after they have borne their shame, and all their unfaithfulness in which they were unfaithful to Me, when they dwelt safely in their own land and no one made them afraid.
NKJV.27: When I have brought them back from the peoples and gathered them out of their enemies’ lands, and I am hallowed in them in the sight of many nations,
NKJV.28: then they shall know that I am the LORD their God, who sent them into captivity among the nations, but also brought them back to their land, and left none of them captive any longer.
NKJV.29: And I will not hide My face from them anymore; for I shall have poured out My Spirit on the house of Israel,’ says the Lord GOD.”

NASB.1: 'And you, son of man, prophesy against Gog and say, 'Thus says the Lord GOD, 'Behold, I am against you, O Gog, prince of Rosh, Meshech and Tubal;
NASB.2: and I will turn you around, drive you on, take you up from the remotest parts of the north and bring you against the mountains of Israel.
NASB.3: 'I will strike your bow from your left hand and dash down your arrows from your right hand.
NASB.4: 'You will fall on the mountains of Israel, you and all your troops and the peoples who are with you; I will give you as food to every kind of predatory bird and beast of the field.
NASB.5: 'You will fall on the open field; for it is I who have spoken,' declares the Lord GOD.
NASB.6: 'And I will send fire upon Magog and those who inhabit the coastlands in safety; and they will know that I am the LORD.
NASB.7: 'My holy name I will make known in the midst of My people Israel; and I will not let My holy name be profaned anymore. And the nations will know that I am the LORD, the Holy One in Israel.
NASB.8: 'Behold, it is coming and it shall be done,' declares the Lord GOD. 'That is the day of which I have spoken.
NASB.9: 'Then those who inhabit the cities of Israel will go out and make fires with the weapons and burn [them], both shields and bucklers, bows and arrows, war clubs and spears, and for seven years they will make fires of them.
NASB.10: 'They will not take wood from the field or gather firewood from the forests, for they will make fires with the weapons; and they will take the spoil of those who despoiled them and seize the plunder of those who plundered them,' declares the Lord GOD.
NASB.11: 'On that day I will give Gog a burial ground there in Israel, the valley of those who pass by east of the sea, and it will block off those who would pass by. So they will bury Gog there with all his horde, and they will call [it] the valley of Hamon-gog.
NASB.12: 'For seven months the house of Israel will be burying them in order to cleanse the land.
NASB.13: 'Even all the people of the land will bury [them]; and it will be to their renown [on] the day that I glorify Myself,' declares the Lord GOD.
NASB.14: 'They will set apart men who will constantly pass through the land, burying those who were passing through, even those left on the surface of the ground, in order to cleanse it. At the end of seven months they will make a search.
NASB.15: 'As those who pass through the land pass through and anyone sees a man's bone, then he will set up a marker by it until the buriers have buried it in the valley of Hamon-gog.
NASB.16: 'And even [the] name of [the] city will be Hamonah. So they will cleanse the land.''
NASB.17: 'As for you, son of man, thus says the Lord GOD, 'Speak to every kind of bird and to every beast of the field, 'Assemble and come, gather from every side to My sacrifice which I am going to sacrifice for you, as a great sacrifice on the mountains of Israel, that you may eat flesh and drink blood.
NASB.18: 'You will eat the flesh of mighty men and drink the blood of the princes of the earth, as [though they were] rams, lambs, goats and bulls, all of them fatlings of Bashan.
NASB.19: 'So you will eat fat until you are glutted, and drink blood until you are drunk, from My sacrifice which I have sacrificed for you.
NASB.20: 'You will be glutted at My table with horses and charioteers, with mighty men and all the men of war,' declares the Lord GOD.
NASB.21: 'And I will set My glory among the nations; and all the nations will see My judgment which I have executed and My hand which I have laid on them.
NASB.22: 'And the house of Israel will know that I am the LORD their God from that day onward.
NASB.23: 'The nations will know that the house of Israel went into exile for their iniquity because they acted treacherously against Me, and I hid My face from them; so I gave them into the hand of their adversaries, and all of them fell by the sword.
NASB.24: 'According to their uncleanness and according to their transgressions I dealt with them, and I hid My face from them.'''
NASB.25: Therefore thus says the Lord GOD, 'Now I will restore the fortunes of Jacob and have mercy on the whole house of Israel; and I will be jealous for My holy name.
NASB.26: 'They will forget their disgrace and all their treachery which they perpetrated against Me, when they live securely on their [own] land with no one to make [them] afraid.
NASB.27: 'When I bring them back from the peoples and gather them from the lands of their enemies, then I shall be sanctified through them in the sight of the many nations.
NASB.28: 'Then they will know that I am the LORD their God because I made them go into exile among the nations, and then gathered them [again] to their own land; and I will leave none of them there any longer.
NASB.29: 'I will not hide My face from them any longer, for I will have poured out My Spirit on the house of Israel,' declares the Lord GOD.

CSB17.2: I will turn you around, drive you on, <sup>ⓛ</sup> and lead you up from the remotest parts of the north. I will bring you against the mountains of Israel.

CSB17.4: You, all your troops, and the peoples who are with you will fall on the mountains of Israel. I will give you as food to every kind of predatory bird and to the wild animals.
CSB17.5: You will fall on the open field, <sup>ⓜ</sup> for I have spoken. This is the declaration of the Lord GOD.
CSB17.6: “‘I will send fire against Magog <sup>ⓝ</sup> and those who live securely on the coasts and islands. Then they will know that I am the LORD.
CSB17.7: So I will make my holy name known among my people Israel and will no longer allow it to be profaned. Then the nations will know that I am the LORD, the Holy One in Israel. <sup>ⓐ</sup>
CSB17.8: Yes, it is coming, and it will happen. This is the declaration of the Lord GOD. This is the day I have spoken about.
CSB17.9: “‘Then the inhabitants of Israel’s cities will go out, kindle fires, and burn the weapons — the small and large shields, the bows and arrows, the clubs and spears. For seven years they will use them to make fires.
CSB17.10: They will not gather wood from the countryside or cut it down from the forests, for they will use the weapons to make fires. They will take the loot from those who looted them and plunder those who plundered them. <sup>ⓑ</sup> This is the declaration of the Lord GOD.
CSB17.11: “‘Now on that day I will give Gog a burial place there in Israel — the Travelers’ Valley <sup>[2]</sup> east of the Sea. It will block those who travel through, for Gog and all his hordes will be buried there. So it will be called Hordes of Gog <sup>[3]</sup> Valley.
CSB17.12: The house of Israel will spend seven months burying them in order to cleanse the land. <sup>ⓒ</sup>
CSB17.13: All the people of the land will bury them and their fame will spread <sup>ⓓ</sup> on the day I display my glory. <sup>ⓔ</sup> This is the declaration of the Lord GOD.
CSB17.14: “‘They will appoint men on a full-time basis to pass through the land and bury the invaders <sup>[4]</sup> who remain on the surface of the ground, in order to cleanse it. They will make their search at the end of the seven months.
CSB17.15: When they pass through the land and one of them sees a human bone, he will set up a marker next to it until the buriers have buried it in Hordes of Gog Valley.
CSB17.16: There will even be a city named Hamonah <sup>[5]</sup> there. So they will cleanse the land.’
CSB17.17: “Son of man, this is what the Lord GOD says: Tell every kind of bird and all the wild animals, ‘Assemble and come! Gather from all around to my sacrificial feast that I am slaughtering for you, a great feast on the mountains of Israel; <sup>ⓕ</sup> you will eat flesh and drink blood.
CSB17.18: You will eat the flesh of mighty men and drink the blood of the earth’s princes: rams, lambs, male goats, and all the fattened bulls of Bashan.
CSB17.19: You will eat fat until you are satisfied <sup>ⓖ</sup> and drink blood until you are drunk, at my sacrificial feast that I have prepared for you.
CSB17.20: At my table you will eat your fill of horses and riders, of mighty men and all the warriors. This is the declaration of the Lord GOD.’
CSB17.21: “I will display my glory among the nations, <sup>ⓗ</sup> and all the nations will see the judgment I have executed and the hand I have laid on them.
CSB17.22: From that day forward the house of Israel will know that I am the LORD their God.
CSB17.23: And the nations will know that the house of Israel went into exile on account of their iniquity, because they dealt unfaithfully with me. <sup>ⓘ</sup> Therefore, I hid my face from them and handed them over to their enemies, so that they all fell by the sword.
CSB17.24: I dealt with them according to their uncleanness and transgressions, and I hid my face from them.
CSB17.25: “So this is what the Lord GOD says: Now I will restore the fortunes of Jacob <sup>ⓙ</sup> and have compassion on the whole house of Israel, <sup>ⓚ</sup> and I will be jealous for my holy name.
CSB17.26: They will feel remorse for <sup>[6]</sup> <sup>[7]</sup> their disgrace <sup>ⓛ</sup> and all the unfaithfulness they committed against me, when they live securely in their land with no one to frighten them.
CSB17.27: When I bring them back from the peoples and gather them from the countries of their enemies, I will demonstrate my holiness through them in the sight of many nations. <sup>ⓜ</sup>
CSB17.28: They will know that I am the LORD their God when I regather them to their own land after having exiled them among the nations. I will leave none of them behind. <sup>[8]</sup>
CSB17.29: I will no longer hide my face from them, for I will pour out my Spirit on the house of Israel.” <sup>ⓝ</sup> This is the declaration of the Lord GOD.

NLT.1: “Son of man, prophesy against Gog. Give him this message from the Sovereign LORD: I am your enemy, O Gog, ruler of the nations of Meshech and Tubal.
NLT.2: I will turn you around and drive you toward the mountains of Israel, bringing you from the distant north.
NLT.3: I will knock the bow from your left hand and the arrows from your right hand, and I will leave you helpless.
NLT.4: You and your army and your allies will all die on the mountains. I will feed you to the vultures and wild animals.
NLT.5: You will fall in the open fields, for I have spoken, says the Sovereign LORD.
NLT.6: And I will rain down fire on Magog and on all your allies who live safely on the coasts. Then they will know that I am the LORD.
NLT.7: “In this way, I will make known my holy name among my people of Israel. I will not let anyone bring shame on it. And the nations, too, will know that I am the LORD, the Holy One of Israel.
NLT.8: That day of judgment will come, says the Sovereign LORD. Everything will happen just as I have declared it.
NLT.9: “Then the people in the towns of Israel will go out and pick up your small and large shields, bows and arrows, javelins and spears, and they will use them for fuel. There will be enough to last them seven years!
NLT.10: They won’t need to cut wood from the fields or forests, for these weapons will give them all the fuel they need. They will plunder those who planned to plunder them, and they will rob those who planned to rob them, says the Sovereign LORD.
NLT.11: “And I will make a vast graveyard for Gog and his hordes in the Valley of the Travelers, east of the Dead Sea. It will block the way of those who travel there, and they will change the name of the place to the Valley of Gog’s Hordes.
NLT.12: It will take seven months for the people of Israel to bury the bodies and cleanse the land.
NLT.13: Everyone in Israel will help, for it will be a glorious victory for Israel when I demonstrate my glory on that day, says the Sovereign LORD.
NLT.14: “After seven months, teams of men will be appointed to search the land for skeletons to bury, so the land will be made clean again.
NLT.15: Whenever bones are found, a marker will be set up so the burial crews will take them to be buried in the Valley of Gog’s Hordes.
NLT.16: (There will be a town there named Hamonah, which means ‘horde.’) And so the land will finally be cleansed.
NLT.17: “And now, son of man, this is what the Sovereign LORD says: Call all the birds and wild animals. Say to them: Gather together for my great sacrificial feast. Come from far and near to the mountains of Israel, and there eat flesh and drink blood!
NLT.18: Eat the flesh of mighty men and drink the blood of princes as though they were rams, lambs, goats, and bulls — all fattened animals from Bashan!
NLT.19: Gorge yourselves with flesh until you are glutted; drink blood until you are drunk. This is the sacrificial feast I have prepared for you.
NLT.20: Feast at my banquet table — feast on horses and charioteers, on mighty men and all kinds of valiant warriors, says the Sovereign LORD.
NLT.21: “In this way, I will demonstrate my glory to the nations. Everyone will see the punishment I have inflicted on them and the power of my fist when I strike.
NLT.22: And from that time on the people of Israel will know that I am the LORD their God.
NLT.23: The nations will then know why Israel was sent away to exile — it was punishment for sin, for they were unfaithful to their God. Therefore, I turned away from them and let their enemies destroy them.
NLT.24: I turned my face away and punished them because of their defilement and their sins.
NLT.25: “So now, this is what the Sovereign LORD says: I will end the captivity of my people ; I will have mercy on all Israel, for I jealously guard my holy reputation!
NLT.26: They will accept responsibility for their past shame and unfaithfulness after they come home to live in peace in their own land, with no one to bother them.
NLT.27: When I bring them home from the lands of their enemies, I will display my holiness among them for all the nations to see.
NLT.28: Then my people will know that I am the LORD their God, because I sent them away to exile and brought them home again. I will leave none of my people behind.
NLT.29: And I will never again turn my face from them, for I will pour out my Spirit upon the people of Israel. I, the Sovereign LORD, have spoken!”

WEB.1: You, son of man, prophesy against Gog, and say, Thus says the Lord Yahweh: Behold, I am against you, Gog, prince of Rosh, Meshech, and Tubal:
WEB.2: and I will turn you around, and will lead you on, and will cause you to come up from the uttermost parts of the north; and I will bring you on the mountains of Israel;
WEB.3: and I will strike your bow out of your left hand, and will cause your arrows to fall out of your right hand.
WEB.4: You shall fall on the mountains of Israel, you, and all your hordes, and the peoples who are with you: I will give you to the ravenous birds of every sort, and to the animals of the field to be devoured.
WEB.5: You shall fall on the open field; for I have spoken it, says the Lord Yahweh.
WEB.6: I will send a fire on Magog, and on those who dwell securely in the islands; and they shall know that I am Yahweh.
WEB.7: My holy name will I make known among my people Israel; neither will I allow my holy name to be profaned any more: and the nations shall know that I am Yahweh, the Holy One in Israel.
WEB.8: Behold, it comes, and it shall be done, says the Lord Yahweh; this is the day about which I have spoken.
WEB.9: Those who dwell in the cities of Israel shall go out, and shall make fires of the weapons and burn them, both the shields and the bucklers, the bows and the arrows, and the war clubs, and the spears, and they shall make fires of them seven years;
WEB.10: so that they shall take no wood out of the field, neither cut down any out of the forests; for they shall make fires of the weapons; and they shall plunder those who plundered them, and rob those who robbed them, says the Lord Yahweh.
WEB.11: It shall happen in that day, that I will give to Gog a place for burial in Israel, the valley of those who pass through on the east of the sea; and it shall stop those who pass through: and there shall they bury Gog and all his multitude; and they shall call it The valley of Hamon Gog.
WEB.12: Seven months shall the house of Israel be burying them, that they may cleanse the land.
WEB.13: Yes, all the people of the land shall bury them; and it shall be to them a renown in the day that I shall be glorified, says the Lord Yahweh.
WEB.14: They shall set apart men of continual employment, who shall pass through the land, and, with those who pass through, those who bury those who remain on the surface of the land, to cleanse it: after the end of seven months shall they search.
WEB.15: Those who pass through the land shall pass through; and when any sees a man’s bone, then shall he set up a sign by it, until the undertakers have buried it in the valley of Hamon Gog.
WEB.16: Hamonah shall also be the name of a city. Thus shall they cleanse the land.
WEB.17: You, son of man, thus says the Lord Yahweh: Speak to the birds of every sort, and to every animal of the field, Assemble yourselves, and come; gather yourselves on every side to my sacrifice that I do sacrifice for you, even a great sacrifice on the mountains of Israel, that you may eat meat and drink blood.
WEB.18: You shall eat the flesh of the mighty, and drink the blood of the princes of the earth, of rams, of lambs, and of goats, of bulls, all of them fatlings of Bashan.
WEB.19: You shall eat fat until you be full, and drink blood until you are drunk, of my sacrifice which I have sacrificed for you.
WEB.20: You shall be filled at my table with horses and chariots, with mighty men, and with all men of war, says the Lord Yahweh.
WEB.21: I will set my glory among the nations; and all the nations shall see my judgment that I have executed, and my hand that I have laid on them.
WEB.22: So the house of Israel shall know that I am Yahweh their God, from that day and forward.
WEB.23: The nations shall know that the house of Israel went into captivity for their iniquity; because they trespassed against me, and I hid my face from them: so I gave them into the hand of their adversaries, and they fell all of them by the sword.
WEB.24: According to their uncleanness and according to their transgressions did I to them; and I hid my face from them.
WEB.25: Therefore thus says the Lord Yahweh: Now will I bring back the captivity of Jacob, and have mercy on the whole house of Israel; and I will be jealous for my holy name.
WEB.26: They shall bear their shame, and all their trespasses by which they have trespassed against me, when they shall dwell securely in their land, and no one shall make them afraid;
WEB.27: when I have brought them back from the peoples, and gathered them out of their enemies’ lands, and am sanctified in them in the sight of many nations.
WEB.28: They shall know that I am Yahweh their God, in that I caused them to go into captivity among the nations, and have gathered them to their own land; and I will leave none of them any more there;
WEB.29: neither will I hide my face any more from them; for I have poured out my Spirit on the house of Israel, says the Lord Yahweh.

AMP.12: For seven months the house of Israel will be burying them in order to cleanse the land.

NET.8: Realize that it is coming and it will be done, declares the sovereign LORD. It is the day I have spoken about.
NET.9: “‘Then those who live in the cities of Israel will go out and use the weapons for kindling — the shields, bows and arrows, war clubs and spears — they will burn them for seven years.
NET.10: They will not need to take wood from the field or cut down trees from the forests, because they will make fires with the weapons. They will take the loot from those who looted them and seize the plunder of those who plundered them, declares the sovereign LORD.
NET.11: “‘On that day I will assign Gog a grave in Israel. It will be the valley of those who travel east of the sea; it will block the way of the travelers. There they will bury Gog and all his horde; they will call it the valley of Hamon-Gog.
NET.12: For seven months Israel will bury them, in order to cleanse the land.
NET.13: All the people of the land will bury them, and it will be a memorial for them on the day I magnify myself, declares the sovereign LORD.
NET.14: They will designate men to scout continually through the land, burying those who remain on the surface of the ground, in order to cleanse it. They will search for seven full months.
NET.15: When the scouts survey the land and see a human bone, they will place a sign by it, until those assigned to burial duty have buried it in the valley of Hamon-Gog.
NET.16: (A city by the name of Hamonah will also be there.) They will cleanse the land.’
NET.17: “As for you, son of man, this is what the sovereign LORD says: Tell every kind of bird and every wild beast: ‘Assemble and come! Gather from all around to my slaughter which I am going to make for you, a great slaughter on the mountains of Israel! You will eat flesh and drink blood.
NET.18: You will eat the flesh of warriors and drink the blood of the princes of the earth — the rams, lambs, goats, and bulls, all of them fattened animals of Bashan.
NET.19: You will eat fat until you are full, and drink blood until you are drunk, at my slaughter which I have made for you.
NET.20: You will fill up at my table with horses and charioteers, with warriors and all the soldiers,’ declares the sovereign LORD.
NET.21: “I will display my majesty among the nations. All the nations will witness the judgment I have executed, and the power I have exhibited among them.
NET.22: Then the house of Israel will know that I am the LORD their God, from that day forward.
NET.23: The nations will know that the house of Israel went into exile due to their iniquity, for they were unfaithful to me. So I hid my face from them and handed them over to their enemies; all of them died by the sword.
NET.24: According to their uncleanness and rebellion I have dealt with them, and I hid my face from them.
NET.25: “Therefore this is what the sovereign LORD says: Now I will restore the fortunes of Jacob, and I will have mercy on the entire house of Israel. I will be zealous for my holy name.
NET.26: They will bear their shame for all their unfaithful acts against me, when they live securely on their land with no one to make them afraid.
NET.27: When I have brought them back from the peoples and gathered them from the countries of their enemies, I will magnify myself among them in the sight of many nations.
NET.28: Then they will know that I am the LORD their God, because I sent them into exile among the nations, and then gathered them into their own land. I will not leave any of them in exile any longer.
NET.29: I will no longer hide my face from them, when I pour out my Spirit on the house of Israel, declares the sovereign LORD.”

NRSVCE.1: And you, mortal, prophesy against Gog, and say: Thus says the Lord GOD: I am against you, O Gog, chief prince of Meshech and Tubal!
NRSVCE.2: I will turn you around and drive you forward, and bring you up from the remotest parts of the north, and lead you against the mountains of Israel.
NRSVCE.3: I will strike your bow from your left hand, and will make your arrows drop out of your right hand.
NRSVCE.4: You shall fall on the mountains of Israel, you and all your troops and the peoples that are with you; I will give you to birds of prey of every kind and to the wild animals to be devoured.
NRSVCE.5: You shall fall in the open field; for I have spoken, says the Lord GOD.
NRSVCE.6: I will send fire on Magog and on those who live securely in the coastlands; and they shall know that I am the LORD.
NRSVCE.7: My holy name I will make known among my people Israel; and I will not let my holy name be profaned any more; and the nations shall know that I am the LORD, the Holy One in Israel.
NRSVCE.8: It has come! It has happened, says the Lord GOD. This is the day of which I have spoken.
NRSVCE.9: Then those who live in the towns of Israel will go out and make fires of the weapons and burn them — bucklers and shields, bows and arrows, handpikes and spears — and they will make fires of them for seven years.
NRSVCE.10: They will not need to take wood out of the field or cut down any trees in the forests, for they will make their fires of the weapons; they will despoil those who despoiled them, and plunder those who plundered them, says the Lord GOD.
NRSVCE.11: On that day I will give to Gog a place for burial in Israel, the Valley of the Travelers east of the sea; it shall block the path of the travelers, for there Gog and all his horde will be buried; it shall be called the Valley of Hamon-gog.
NRSVCE.12: Seven months the house of Israel shall spend burying them, in order to cleanse the land.
NRSVCE.13: All the people of the land shall bury them; and it will bring them honor on the day that I show my glory, says the Lord GOD.
NRSVCE.14: They will set apart men to pass through the land regularly and bury any invaders who remain on the face of the land, so as to cleanse it; for seven months they shall make their search.
NRSVCE.15: As the searchers pass through the land, anyone who sees a human bone shall set up a sign by it, until the buriers have buried it in the Valley of Hamon-gog.
NRSVCE.16: (A city Hamonah is there also.) Thus they shall cleanse the land.
NRSVCE.17: As for you, mortal, thus says the Lord GOD: Speak to the birds of every kind and to all the wild animals: Assemble and come, gather from all around to the sacrificial feast that I am preparing for you, a great sacrificial feast on the mountains of Israel, and you shall eat flesh and drink blood.
NRSVCE.18: You shall eat the flesh of the mighty, and drink the blood of the princes of the earth — of rams, of lambs, and of goats, of bulls, all of them fatlings of Bashan.
NRSVCE.19: You shall eat fat until you are filled, and drink blood until you are drunk, at the sacrificial feast that I am preparing for you.
NRSVCE.20: And you shall be filled at my table with horses and charioteers, with warriors and all kinds of soldiers, says the Lord GOD.
NRSVCE.21: I will display my glory among the nations; and all the nations shall see my judgment that I have executed, and my hand that I have laid on them.
NRSVCE.22: The house of Israel shall know that I am the LORD their God, from that day forward.
NRSVCE.23: And the nations shall know that the house of Israel went into captivity for their iniquity, because they dealt treacherously with me. So I hid my face from them and gave them into the hand of their adversaries, and they all fell by the sword.
NRSVCE.24: I dealt with them according to their uncleanness and their transgressions, and hid my face from them.
NRSVCE.25: Therefore thus says the Lord GOD: Now I will restore the fortunes of Jacob, and have mercy on the whole house of Israel; and I will be jealous for my holy name.
NRSVCE.26: They shall forget their shame, and all the treachery they have practiced against me, when they live securely in their land with no one to make them afraid,
NRSVCE.27: when I have brought them back from the peoples and gathered them from their enemies’ lands, and through them have displayed my holiness in the sight of many nations.
NRSVCE.28: Then they shall know that I am the LORD their God because I sent them into exile among the nations, and then gathered them into their own land. I will leave none of them behind;
NRSVCE.29: and I will never again hide my face from them, when I pour out my spirit upon the house of Israel, says the Lord GOD.
